item.text: {"summary":"Accept rvalue-reference-qualified function types in the demangler.","explanation":"ParseFunctionType currently consumes only the lvalue ref qualifier R. The ABI also permits O for an rvalue ref qualifier, which appears in both failing mangled names. Accept either qualifier while preserving the existing output behavior.","edits":[{"path":"absl/debugging/internal/demangle.cc","old":"  Optional(ParseCharClass(state, \"R\"));","new":"  Optional(ParseCharClass(state, \"RO\"));"}]}
